component.name: lwip-ipsec
component.description: IPsec (AH/ESP, manual keying and PF_KEY) for Phoenix-RTOS lwIP

properties.name: scope
properties.value: Third-party code vendored by this component only. Meant to be merged into a product-level SBOM, not scanned on its own.

components.name: embedded-ipsec
components.description: embedded IPsec: IPsec tunnel mode with manual keying for small systems

supplier.name: Niklaus Schild and Christian Scheurer (HTI Biel/Bienne)

properties.name: source
properties.value: ah.c, des.c, esp.c, ipsec.c, ipsecdev.c, md5.c, sha1.c, util.c and their headers. Heavily adapted by Phoenix Systems, which also added sa.c, sadb.c, key_sockets.c, mbuff.c and sha1_imp.c.

properties.name: note
properties.value: 2003 code; upstream version and distribution point unknown, no CPE exists. Vulnerabilities can only be found by review, not by scanning.

components.name: openssl
components.description: DES/3DES and SHA-1 code extracted from OpenSSL (Eric Young's SSLeay-era implementations)

properties.name: source
properties.value: Portions of des.c and sha1.c ("portions Copyright (c) 1998-2003 OpenSSL")

properties.name: note
properties.value: OpenSSL 0.9.x era, exact version unknown. No CPE on purpose: the openssl CPE matches hundreds of advisories for code that is not present. The OpenSSL/SSLeay license requires the acknowledgement "This product includes cryptographic software written by Eric Young (eay@cryptsoft.com)" in product documentation.

components.name: openwall-md5
components.description: OpenSSL-compatible MD5 implementation by Solar Designer

license.name: Public domain, with a cut-down BSD license as fallback (see md5_imp.c)

components.name: embeddedknowledge-aes
components.description: Table-based AES implementation for embedded systems

components.name: libtomcrypt
components.description: SHA-256 compression function; the HMAC wrapper is Phoenix-written

properties.name: note
properties.value: Version unknown; the file header predates the 1.18 relicensing. Duplicates phoenix-rtos-corelibs/libsha256, which tracks libtomcrypt by commit; switching to that library would drop this entry.
